title: Scope Refactoring Result
description: Return of the scope-refactoring agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, and the code and test issues in the shape of issues.schema.json

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question (such as what the task wants refactored where it does not say), or an empty string. Explanations of your choices go in notes, never here

notes.description: What you want to explain about your choices, in plain words, or an empty string. No gate reads it and it never stops the run

file.description: File path where issue was found
File path where issue was found
